subject: Onsite logistics — charge holds, PO splits, and attendee stipends
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-12T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite planning — SF exec workshop (payment & card question)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the venue details. We’re finalizing our attendee list and finance has asked whether we can put a temporary hold on a Redwood corporate card to cover venue catering and two-night hotel blocks for five Acme attendees.

Details: estimated charges $9,400 (venue + catering), hotel block $3,200 (5 rooms, 2 nights). Our procurement team prefers a single vendor invoice but requires a PO+card reconciliation sheet. Can Redwood either (a) accept a PO and issue an invoice after the event, or (b) allow a one-time card authorization with itemized receipts submitted within 7 days?

Attaching our attendee list and preferred billing contact.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Events, Acme Corp
Alicia.Gomez@acme.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: workshop_attendee_list.xlsx
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite planning — SF exec workshop (payment & card question)

Hi Alicia — great to meet you over email.

We can do either PO+invoice or a one-time card authorization. Two quick notes so we can lock the approach:
- If you want PO+invoice, we’ll need the PO number by Monday (2025-11-17) to route through our Finance/AR queue for pre-approval. Invoicing will be net 30 unless you request alternate terms.
- If you prefer a one-time corporate card auth, our standard is: pre-authorize up to the estimated total, submit itemized receipts within 7 business days, and Finance will run a reconciliation. For anything above $10k we require manager approval (we're close to that threshold with your numbers).

For hotel blocks specifically, we can either charge the hotel directly (via card auth) or accept individual attendee reimbursements against the PO; hotel incidentals must be handled by the cardholder.

I’ve copied Marissa from Finance to advise on the approval path and Connor for final sign-off if we need a one-time exception to the $10k manager threshold.

Next steps: reply with preferred billing method and whether Acme will provide a PO. If card auth, please confirm the exact amount to pre-authorize (we can put a 10% buffer).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-12T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite logistics — charge holds, PO splits, and attendee stipends

Thanks — looping Finance notes:

1) PO route: we can accept PO+invoice. Please send PO to ar@redwood.com with line items matched to the attached expense_template.csv. Invoicing lead time: 2 business days after event close (we need receipts attached).

2) Card auth route: we can do one-time corporate card authorizations for vendor charges (venue, catering, group hotel), but two policy points:
   - Any single-authorized charge >= $10,000 requires Director-level sign-off.
   - Card authorizations must be reconciled with itemized receipts within 7 business days; otherwise Finance flags the charge and it may be put on hold pending investigation.

3) Stipends / per diems: If Acme plans to give attendee stipends (travel stipends), those should be on the PO as a separate line item and will be treated as taxable benefits — we need names + emails to issue correct 1099-equivalents (US) or local tax forms for non-US attendees.

4) Recommended approach for this event (based on numbers): Accept PO for the venue + stipends; use a card auth only for the hotel block (reconciled by hotel invoice). That keeps the largest amounts on PO/invoice for AR and reduces one-off card risk.

I’ve attached the standard template and a reconciliation checklist.

Attachments: expense_template.csv, draft_agenda.pdf

-Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-13T08:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite logistics — charge holds, PO splits, and attendee stipends

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifications from procurement:

• PO will be issued for venue + stipends, PO# to follow today. We need your firm billing address and W-9 (we’ve already received your bank onboarding items).
• For the hotel block: can Redwood accept a split billing where Acme covers rooms and Redwood covers meeting room charges/catering? Our internal travel policy requires cardholder names for any direct-bill rooms.

Two requests that may require exception handling:
1) We have one VIP attendee who prefers to book their own refundable room and be reimbursed. Will Redwood accept a direct reimbursement against the PO?
2) The total estimated invoice lines are: Venue $6,200; Catering $3,200; Stipends $2,500. PO total $11,900. Given that exceeds $10k, how long for Director sign-off if we go PO route? We’re trying to avoid delaying vendor confirmations.

Thanks,
Procurement Team (on behalf of Alicia)
procurement@acme.com

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-14T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite logistics — charge holds, PO splits, and attendee stipends

Understood — I’m approving a one-time Director-level sign-off to allow either flow (PO or card auth) to proceed this week to avoid hold-ups. Conditions:
1) If Acme sends a PO (preferred), Redwood Finance will invoice net 30; include attendee names for stipends so we can process correctly.
2) If Acme requests card auth for hotel, authorize up to $3,200 with a 10% buffer and stipulate the hotel will bill the final room charges to Redwood; we require itemized hotel invoice within 7 business days after checkout.
3) For the VIP who wants reimbursement: permitted if pre-approved — Acme must include attendee in the PO or provide an individual reimbursement form signed by their manager.

Marissa — please flag any charge that doesn’t have receipts within 7 business days and loop me if we see unresolved items. Soojin — please confirm the PO number and we’ll mark the booking as cleared on our side.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
VP, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
